list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Centrosymmetric, distorted hexagonal metallomacrocycle formed by two Yb centers and four nitrogen atoms from two bridging diamide ligands. Each Yb has a distorted trigonal-bipyramidal environment comprising two diamide nitrogen atoms, one chloride and two THF oxygen atoms.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon in a Schlenk flask, dissolve p-(Me3SiNH)2C6H4 in THF and cool to 0 °C. Add n-BuLi, warm slowly to room temperature and stir for 1 h. Add the solution slowly to a slurry of anhydrous YbCl3 in THF, then stir at room temperature for 48 h.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C initially; room temperature for reaction; 0 °C for crystallization
synthesis.time: 1 h after warming, 48 h after addition to YbCl3, then 2 days for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk flask; salt-metathesis reaction under argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove solvent in vacuo, extract the residue with toluene, remove LiCl by centrifugation, concentrate the extracts and crystallize at 0 °C to obtain orange-red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Centrosymmetric, cage-like tetranuclear metallomacrocycle formed by four Nd centers linked through four bridging diamide ligands and bridging chlorides. Each Nd binds two diamide nitrogen atoms, two asymmetrically bridging chlorides and one THF oxygen atom in a distorted trigonal-bipyramidal environment. The article attributes the cage-like form in part to weak Nd–aromatic-carbon interactions with phenyl rings.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon in a Schlenk flask, dissolve p-(Me3SiNH)2C6H4 in THF and cool to 0 °C. Add n-BuLi, warm slowly to room temperature and stir for 1 h. Add the solution slowly to a slurry of anhydrous NdCl3 in THF, then stir at room temperature for 48 h.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C initially; room temperature for reaction and crystallization
synthesis.time: 1 h after warming, 48 h after addition to NdCl3, then 1 day for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk flask; salt-metathesis reaction under argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove solvent in vacuo, extract the residue with toluene, remove LiCl by centrifugation, concentrate the extracts and crystallize at room temperature to obtain blue-green crystals.
